statement: Suppose that V is a stationary integral m-varifold in an open subset of Rm+n and that m − 1 < s < dimH Sing(V ). After a translation there exist a fixed point 0 ∈ Sing(V ), an integer Q ≥ 1, an m-plane Π through zero, radii Li ↓ 0, and positive Radon measures σi such that ΘV (0) = Q, VLi ⇀ Q|Π| locally in Rm+n . (2.2) 4 Each σi is supported in B1 on singular points of VLi having density exactly Q. There are constants c, C > 0, independent of i, for which σi(Bu(X)) ≤ Cus (X ∈ Rm+n , u > 0), c ≤ σi(B1) ≤ C.
